title: Standardize zone and subgraph boundary styling
description: Apply a subtle same-family outline to zone areas and render subgraph guides with square orthogonal corners across shared 2D views.
completion_criteria: Zone areas retain their translucent fill and gain a thin outline from the same palette family.
Subgraph area guides use square right-angle corners in every shared 2D renderer.
Zone outlines remain solid and subgraph outlines remain dashed.
Focused render and topology tests plus typecheck and build pass.
The local demo visually confirms both styles while the development server remains available.
evidence: Focused render and topology suite: 72 tests passed.
npm run build passed; only the existing bundle-size warning remains.
Local browser verification confirmed zone fill rgba(237,248,243,0.3), same-family solid 1px stroke rgba(59,148,111,0.55), and subgraph fill none with dashed stroke and rx/ry 0.
Development server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
notes: Implementation is scoped to shared SVG area rendering and palette variables; DSL semantics and layout geometry remain unchanged.
